description: This file contains functions related to pruning packed objects within a Git repository, including removing duplicate objects and handling progress display.

methods.name: int prune_subdir(unsigned int nr,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Handles directory pruning and progress display, deletes directories unless in dry run mode.

methods.name: int prune_object(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Checks for object presence in pack, prints removal command or deletes file based on dry run flag.

methods.name: void prune_packed_objects(int opts)
methods.description: Main function to prune duplicate objects from the repository, manages progress display.

ctags.name: prune_object
ctags.pattern: /^static int prune_object(const struct object_id *oid, const char *path,$/
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)

ctags.name: prune_subdir
